description.narrative: (Uganda): With FY 2022 MCH and FP funds, the Civil Society Strengthening Activity (CSSA) improves the ability of Ugandan Civil Society Organizations (CSOs) to influence and contribute to development outcomes in targeted sectors, including health; agriculture; food security; and democracy, human rights, and governance.The Activity provides technical assistance to strengthen the advocacy capacity of CSOs to influence policies across the sectors of health and HIV/AIDS, family planning, child and maternal health, agriculture and democracy. The Civil Society Strengthening activity will provide support to civil society organizations (CSOs) across the Mission's portfolio to increase cross-sector cooperation, strengthen cohesiveness and improve linkages to government. This integrated activity will advance Mission priorities in health, education, and economic growth. Interventions will include expanding the voice of local CSOs within networks, increasing their capacity to express interests; supporting civil society and media to partner effectively with local government; and strengthening the organizational capacity of CSOs for policy analysis and oversight, advocacy, coalition building, internal governance, and membership representation. CSSA will also fund activities to improve gender equality and empower women to access and use high quality health services, and activities that prevent gender-based violence and address the impact of gender-based violence...
